MEDIA TECHNOLOGY — TERMLY EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MEDIA TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. CPU
   C. Keyboard
   D. Monitor

2. When learning Fundamentals of Emerging Media Technology 1.2 Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 , the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Fundamentals of Emerging Media Technology 1.2 Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 .
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fundamentals of Emerging Media Technology 1.2 Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 .
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fundamentals of Emerging Media Technology 1.2 Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 .
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fundamentals of Emerging Media Technology 1.2 Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 .

3. When learning Digital Video Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Digital Video Production.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Digital Video Production.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Digital Video Production.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Digital Video Production.

4. When learning Fundamentals of Media Technology, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fundamentals of Media Technology.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fundamentals of Media Technology.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fundamentals of Media Technology.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Fundamentals of Media Technology.

5. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Overload every socket

6. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. International Cricket Team

7. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Remove all guards

8. When learning Pre- production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre- production.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre- production.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pre- production.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Pre- production.

9. When learning Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Production.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Production.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Production.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Production.

10. When learning Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Med, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Med.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Med.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Med.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Med.

11. When learning Photography: technology and techniques 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Pr, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Photography: technology and techniques 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Pr.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Photography: technology and techniques 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Pr.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Photography: technology and techniques 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Pr.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Photography: technology and techniques 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Pr.

12. When learning Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media.

13. When learning Live streaming Project, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Live streaming Project.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Live streaming Project.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Live streaming Project.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Live streaming Project.

14. When learning Photography: technology and techniques, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Photography: technology and techniques.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Photography: technology and techniques.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Photography: technology and techniques.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Photography: technology and techniques.

15. When learning Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography: techn, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography: techn.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography: techn.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography: techn.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography: techn.

16. When learning Post- production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Post- production.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Post- production.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Post- production.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Post- production.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Production and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography: techn and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Post- production and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Live streaming Project and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Photography: technology and techniques 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Pr and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Photography: technology and techniques and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
